fee_notes: Non-refundable, fully earned upon signing. Additional $10,000 Integration Fee required for new franchisees and conversions. Existing franchisees developing additional facilities are exempt from Integration Fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee in the amount of $10,000 in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The initial franchise fee is non-refundable and fully earned by us when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
